body.p: After . Owns src/schema_complex_type.c, new src/schema_content_model.c, tests/schema_content_model_test.c. Complex type definitions: simple and complex content by extension and restriction (cos-ct-extends, derivation-ok-restriction; restriction of content checked as language inclusion of the two automata, XSD 1.1 Part 1, 3.4.6.4), attribute uses and wildcards (cos-aw-union, cos-aw-intersect), defaultAttributes, registration of the complex type (content type variety and simple content type). Content models: the particle tree compiled to a deterministic automaton whose transitions are element declarations and wildcards, with counters for maxOccurs beyond a small bound (so large values cost a counter, not states, within maximum_content_model_state_count), Unique Particle Attribution (cos-nonambig, with XSD 1.1's rule that an element particle wins over a wildcard), Element Declarations Consistent (cos-element-consistent), XSD 1.1 all groups (counted members, wildcards, maxOccurs above 1), open content (interleave and suffix modes, the schema's default open content), substitution groups in element particles (cos-equiv-derived-ok-rec, blocking), and the matcher the validator steps (start, child element name to a declaration or wildcard, end, with the expected names for error messages). Done when MS-Particles, MS-ModelGroups, MS-Group, MS-ComplexType, MS-Wildcards, Sun MGroup and CType, Saxon All and Open, IBM allGroup and openContent ≥ 80% once 5.7 runs them; unit tests of the automaton first. Golden: src/regex.c (compiled program, explicit stacks), src/types.c. Done 2026-10-18 (): COMPLEX_TYPES and content models with unit tests; the groups' schema tests pass 96 % or more with 5.4's reader (MS-Particles 851 of 853); their instance tests are measured once 5.7 validates.
